summary: iter-400 (Replacement-implant Bone & Soft Tissue Augmentation): Verified backend persistence via 3 pytest cases (with-aug, without-aug, login) — all PASS. Verified UI end-to-end on /procedures/survival-review/{id}: selecting Failed → picking reason → replaced Yes → reveals replacement block with the NEW 'Bone and Soft Tissue Augmentation' pill toggle (defaults No, testids imp-0-repl-aug-yes / imp-0-repl-aug-no both present). Clicking Yes reveals imp-0-repl-aug-form containing the full AugStep2Form (proc-trigger, auto-yes/no, material-trigger, membrane-yes/no, fixation-trigger, stt-yes/no, healing-trigger). Toggling back to No hides the form. Phase 2 aug testids (p2-aug-yes/p2-aug-no) remain present in submit-phase2/[id].tsx (regression source-verified). Case-detail display (2a): the 'Augmentation: <summary>' line RENDERS VISIBLY on the active R1 tile with the expected content ('Augmentation: Guided Bone Regeneration (GBR) · Graft: Autogenous · Membrane: Resorbable Collagen · Healing: Submerged'), BUT the required data-testid attributes `implant-revision-active-aug-{idx}` and `implant-revision-active-{idx}` do NOT appear on the DOM — the JSX only sets `data-testid` on the View/Text without a matching `testID` prop, and React-Native-Web only forwards data-testid to the DOM when the `testID` prop is used.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid attributes `implant-revision-active-{idx}` and `implant-revision-active-aug-{idx}` are NOT emitted to the DOM. React-Native-Web only converts the `testID` prop to a data-testid DOM attribute; a bare JSX `data-testid` prop on <View>/<Text> is dropped. Add a matching `testID={...}` alongside every `data-testid={...}` (same pattern already used on the sibling `implant-plan-status-${idx}` and `implant-lifecycle-timeline` which DO render).
Likely same issue on the failed-chain tile testid `implant-revision-aug-{idx}-r{n}` — please add matching `testID` and re-verify.

action_items: Add `testID={...}` prop matching every `data-testid={...}` on <View>/<Text> in CaseImplantPlanning.tsx for the active-revision tile (line 1117) and the augmentation summary lines (lines 1080, 1149), otherwise external test harnesses cannot select them (the visible feature already works).

rca of the issue: React-Native-Web forwards `testID` prop as `data-testid` DOM attribute; it does NOT forward a JSX `data-testid` prop by itself on RN primitives (<View>, <Text>). CaseImplantPlanning.tsx lines 1117 and 1149 (and 1080 on the chain-tile) declare `data-testid=` without a companion `testID=`. Mitigation: add `testID={...}` alongside every `data-testid={...}` (already the pattern for `implant-plan-status-${idx}` on line 882-883).
